description: Source code for menu configuration handling in a Linux kernel or similar project, including menu management, dependency rewriting, property handling, and help text generation.

methods.name: menu_warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to a menu item, including filename and line number.

methods.name: prop_warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to a property, including filename and line number.

methods.name: _menu_init
methods.description: Initializes current menu and entry pointers to root menu.

methods.name: menu_add_entry
methods.description: Adds a new menu entry associated with a symbol.

methods.name: menu_add_menu
methods.description: Begins a new submenu, returning the current menu.

methods.name: menu_end_menu
methods.description: Ends the current menu, returning to parent menu.

methods.name: rewrite_m
methods.description: Rewrites expressions to include MODULES dependency for 'm'.

methods.name: menu_add_dep
methods.description: Adds a dependency expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: menu_set_type
methods.description: Sets the type of the current symbol, warning if redefinition occurs.

methods.name: menu_add_prop
methods.description: Adds a property to the current menu entry.

methods.name: menu_add_prompt
methods.description: Adds a prompt property to the current menu, propagating visibility.

methods.name: menu_add_visibility
methods.description: Adds a visibility expression to the current menu.

methods.name: menu_add_expr
methods.description: Adds an expression property to the current menu.

methods.name: menu_add_symbol
methods.description: Adds a symbol property to the current menu.

methods.name: menu_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes a menu node, processing children, dependencies, and properties.

methods.name: menu_has_prompt
methods.description: Checks if a menu has a prompt.

methods.name: menu_is_empty
methods.description: Determines if a menu is empty or only contains invisible entries.

methods.name: menu_is_visible
methods.description: Determines if a menu is visible based on dependencies and symbol states.

methods.name: menu_get_prompt
methods.description: Returns the prompt text for a menu.

methods.name: menu_get_parent_menu
methods.description: Returns the parent menu of a given menu.

methods.name: menu_has_help
methods.description: Checks if a menu has help text.

methods.name: menu_get_help
methods.description: Retrieves help text for a menu.

methods.name: menu_get_ext_help
methods.description: Generates extended help information for a menu, including dependencies and location.
